summary: End-to-end verification of the new 'Generate with AI' name generator on Profile > Name list (random). Backend POST /api/generate-names is wired to Groq (openai/gpt-oss-120b) using GROQ_API_KEY/GROQ_MODEL from frontend/.env. Auth guard, validation, and JSON-object response parsing all behave correctly. UI dialog renders with correct data-testids, defaults quantity=20 and the Bengali-request-derived prompt, and appends generated names to #name_list without wiping existing content.
critical_code_review_comments: route.ts correctly clamps quantity 1-500, requires prompt, dedupes case-insensitive, slices to requested length, returns 401/400/502 with clear error messages, and never leaks the API key.
GenerateNamesDialog uses controlled quantity/prompt state, disables submit while loading or when inputs empty, closes on success only, shows toast on both success/error - solid UX.

profile-section.tsx appends via setNameList((prev)=>prev?`${prev}
${names.join('
')}`:names.join('
')) - guarantees append semantics, verified with seed 'SeedName1/2' + 5 names + 3 more names all preserved in order.

Occasional upstream Groq 502 observed when firing multiple generation requests within ~30s (rate limiting on the user's Groq key). Backend surfaces it as 502 with error text and UI shows a toast; not a code bug, just a note for the user.
test_credentials: Panel login iamhear/iamhear/iamhear (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Groq key sourced from frontend/.env, never logged.
seed_data_creation: None. Typed 'SeedName1/SeedName2' into the Profile > Name list textarea during append test and cleared it before finishing. 'Apply to selected' was never clicked, so no real Telegram account was modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature scope: Profile > Name list (random) shows a 'Generate with AI' button (data-testid=generate-names-open) next to the label; opens a dialog with data-testid generate-names-quantity/prompt/submit; backend at POST /api/generate-names uses Groq. Groq occasionally returns 502 under rapid-fire calls - a single retry is enough. Panel is on LIVE Neon DB with 499 real Telegram accounts; do NOT click 'Apply to selected', delete accounts, or run LS_Python workers.
verified_scenarios: POST with only quantity, no prompt -> 400 'Enter a prompt describing the name styles.'
POST authed quantity=3 -> 200 with exactly 3 names (['Arif-SailorMoon 🌙','Sharmeen-Naruto 🍜','Jahan-Mikasa ⚔️'])
POST authed quantity=25 -> 200 with 25 unique names mixing Bangladeshi/anime/trading styles + emoji
Custom prompt 'only single-word anime names, no emoji' -> 200 with names like Naruto/Bleach/Gintama/Akira - constraints honoured
UI: login OK, no 'Database not connected' banner, Profile section renders with mode toggle, username, photo picker
UI: 'Generate with AI' button visible beside Name list label; dialog shows correct default quantity (20) and full styles prompt
UI: setting quantity=6 & submitting appended exactly 6 unique names to #name_list, dialog closed, success toast
